UpSet plot of feature sets with vertically aligned enrichment dot matrix

Source: R/plot_upset_v.R
plot_upset_v.Rd

Draws a ComplexHeatmap UpSet plot with intersections as columns and a clusterProfiler-style enrichment dot matrix underneath. The two panels use the same intersection order, so each enrichment column is vertically aligned with its UpSet intersection.

Usage

plot_upset_v(
  set_list,
  enrich_list = NULL,
  enrich_category = NULL,
  enrich_top_n = 3,
  include_all = TRUE,
  enrich_rank_by = "p.adjust",
  set_order = NULL,
  intersection_order = NULL,
  intersection_labels = NULL,
  intersection_colours = NULL,
  fontsize = 8,
  dot_size_col = "Count",
  dot_colour_col = "p.adjust",
  dot_min_size = 1,
  dot_max_size = 3,
  dot_outline = "black",
  dot_outline_width = 0.5,
  term_wrap_width = 30,
  row_gap_mm = 2,
  show_dot_column_names = FALSE,
  enrich_term_order = "rank",
  enrich_term_colours = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

set_list

A named list of character vectors of feature sets.

enrich_list

A named enrichment list for intersections, such as the output of enrichGO_list()$all or enrichR_list(). Each named element should be a data.frame with Cluster, Description, and the columns named by enrich_rank_by, dot_size_col, and dot_colour_col. If NULL (default), no enrichment terms are displayed. The Cluster column may contain binary combination names or displayed UpSet labels. Displayed labels are auto-generated from names(set_list) by joining participating set names with _, and may be overridden with intersection_labels. When enrich_category is a vector, each category is shown as a separate row section in the enrichment dot matrix.

enrich_category

Category name(s) of enrichment to display: a single string (e.g. "BP"), or a vector for multiple categories (e.g. c("BP", "CC")). Categories must be present in enrich_list.

enrich_top_n

Top N enrichment terms per intersection. A single integer (default: 3) is recycled for all categories in enrich_category. Supply an integer vector of matching length for per-category control.

include_all

Whether to include every occurrence of a term selected in any intersection, matching clusterProfiler's includeAll. (default: TRUE).

enrich_rank_by

Numeric column used to rank enrichment terms within each intersection. A single string (default: "p.adjust") is recycled for all categories in enrich_category. Supply a character vector of matching length for per-category control.

set_order

Optional order of the sets. When NULL (default), sets are ordered by decreasing size. Pass a character vector of set names to control display order.

intersection_order

Optional order of intersection columns. When NULL (default), intersections are ordered by decreasing combination size. Pass a character vector of combination names (as returned by ComplexHeatmap::comb_name()), or a numeric permutation of their indices, to specify a custom order.

intersection_labels

Optional named character vector mapping comb_name binary patterns to custom intersection names, overriding the auto-generated defaults. E.g., c("1010" = "Concordant_Up", "0101" = "Concordant_Down"). Entries for patterns not present in the combination matrix cause an error.

intersection_colours

Optional named colour vector for intersections. Names must match the binary combination patterns used by intersection_labels (e.g. "1010"). Colours are used for the intersection bars and combination marks.

fontsize

Base font size. Default is 8.

dot_size_col

Numeric column used for dot size in the enrichment annotation. Default is "Count".

dot_colour_col

Numeric column used for dot colour in the enrichment annotation. Default is "p.adjust".

dot_min_size

Minimum dot radius in mm. Default is 1.

dot_max_size

Maximum dot radius in mm. Default is 3.

dot_outline

Outline colour for enrichment dots. Use NA to remove outlines. Default is "black".

dot_outline_width

Outline width in points. Default is 0.5.

term_wrap_width

Maximum characters per displayed enrichment term before wrapping to a new line. Default is 30.

row_gap_mm

Gap between enrichment categories in mm. Default is 2.

show_dot_column_names

Whether to show intersection labels on the enrichment dot matrix. Default: FALSE.

enrich_term_order

Controls how to order the enrichment term rows. "rank" (default) orders terms by their best enrich_rank_by value. "intersection" groups terms by intersection_order, with terms within each intersection ordered by enrich_rank_by.

enrich_term_colours

Optional named colour vector for enrichment terms. Names are matched to enrichment ID values when available, and then to Description values. Unspecified terms remain black.

...

Additional arguments passed to ComplexHeatmap::UpSet().

Value

A ComplexHeatmap UpSet plot, with optional enrichment dot annotations.

Details

The binary combination pattern and displayed intersection label are printed when the function is called. These mappings can be used as keys for intersection_labels and intersection_colours.

References

Dot matrix mimicking clusterProfiler::dotplot()

Examples

# Mock feature sets with reproducible intersections
genes <- paste0("G", 1:200)
set_list <- list(Exp1_Up = genes[1:60], Exp1_Down = genes[61:100],
    Exp2_Up = genes[c(1:40, 101:115)], Exp2_Down = genes[c(61:80, 116:130)])
enrich_list <- list(BP = data.frame(
    Cluster = c("Exp1_Up_Exp2_Up", "Exp1_Down_Exp2_Down"),
    Description = c("term A", "term B"), p.adjust = c(0.001, 0.04),
    Count = c(10, 5)))
intersection_colours <- c("1010" = "#0072B5", "0101" = "#D55E00")
plot_upset_v(set_list, enrich_list = enrich_list,
    enrich_category = "BP", intersection_colours = intersection_colours)
#> Intersection pattern to label mapping:
#>   1010: Exp1_Up_Exp2_Up
#>   0101: Exp1_Down_Exp2_Down
#>   1000: Exp1_Up
#>   0100: Exp1_Down
#>   0010: Exp2_Up
#>   0001: Exp2_Down

# Custom intersection order uses the binary combination patterns.
plot_upset_v(set_list,
    intersection_order = c("1010", "1000", "0101", "0100", "0010", "0001"))
#> Intersection pattern to label mapping:
#>   1010: Exp1_Up_Exp2_Up
#>   0101: Exp1_Down_Exp2_Down
#>   1000: Exp1_Up
#>   0100: Exp1_Down
#>   0010: Exp2_Up
#>   0001: Exp2_Down
